text: Your ketone strategy decides how you handle salt, since the salts bring their own sodium while the diet drains it. If you're in a crisis and need the fog to lift fast, there's Strategy A, the "Crisis Mode". You drink BHB (beta-hydroxybutyrate) salts and keep eating a standard low-sugar diet. In trials, ketone esters, salts and MCT oil improved thinking a little against a placebo, from a single dose as well as over two weeks or more (Bonnechère, et al, 2026). Amazon reviews do show many folks noting increased mental clarity, though.
section: Fixing ATP Signaling if Cortisol Isn't High
reader: someone with trauma and brain fog choosing between the two ketone strategies, about to drink BHB salts or start the keto diet, who wants to know what each asks of them and what the salts will do for the fog
